cmp_navy18_resolve_hq_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_navy18_spawn_state
    clear_saved_scope = cmp_navy18_hq_region
    ordered_scope_state = { limit = { has_decree = decree_sakuya_mark_state owner = root has_port_state = yes } order_by = gdp position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = cmp_navy18_spawn_state }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:cmp_navy18_spawn_state } scope:cmp_navy18_spawn_state = { region = { save_scope_as = cmp_navy18_hq_region } } }
}
